repair_of: unit-v2.json (GLOBAL weak-substitution table false-passed non-words built by inserting hamza into sound-slot templates, e.g. the mafuul and tafiil shapes; claimed penult marks were trusted without the written surface; weak realization was undeclared — Sol fix-request round 2, finding 1)

rules.text: a template matches only with supplied root radicals filling R1..R3 in order (no root derivation in the consumer)
mu_participle without a known penult vowel -> abstain penult_vowel_unknown (never default to active)
gloss SHAPE is nominal for every class here; the consumer flags (does not author) any verbal-gloss pairing
zero or >1 surviving template -> abstain (ambiguous_template or no_template)
a weak radical may surface only via the substitutions the pack licenses FOR THAT TEMPLATE (by_template scope); a substitution licensed for one template never licenses another
a claimed penult surface mark must be verifiable on the written surface: unpointed surface -> penult_mark_not_in_surface; differing written mark -> penult_mark_mismatch (never trust the claim alone)

any exercised weak substitution, and any voice split over a weak-radical root, requires the exact bound weak declaration (weak_position + weak_radical) in the root evidence -> otherwise weak_declaration_unbound
